fields.subject: SqlParameters
fields.where: a caller materializes a parameter for a Query contract
fields.trigger: the caller invokes a typed scalar input or output parameter extension
fields.response: append exactly one parameter to the supplied collection with an `@`-prefixed name and the overload-selected SQL type; input parameters shall be marked Input and carry the supplied value (or database null for nullable scalar inputs), while output parameters shall be marked Output.
